note: WAEC Marketing round 7 (R35 top-up): the four Ansoff growth strategies; harvesting; cannibalisation; repositioning; irregular demand; market potential; delighted customers; the right to redress; unsought goods; installations; the slogan; celebrity endorsement; comparative advertising; newspaper copy advantage; the with-pack premium; sweepstakes; the promotional allowance; pre-approach; price fixing; predatory pricing; the co-operative store; the cash-and-carry wholesaler; the franchising royalty; affiliate marketing; the lead magnet; cost per mille; buying by tender; the press conference; lobbying as public relations. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-6, NECO Marketing (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
